summary: P0 production bug fix VERIFIED: Back-filling missing organization_config and subscription data on login. All 17 backend tests passed. Login now correctly creates org_config (with industry_type) and trial subscription for existing users missing this data. /api/addons/enabled-modules returns ALL 5 core modules plus industry-specific addon modules.

working_correctly: Login with password returns all modules for users with complete data
/api/addons/enabled-modules returns ALL core modules: system_pulse, client_engagement, execution_hub, business_clarity, settings
/api/addons/enabled-modules returns industry-specific addon modules based on industry_type
ensure_user_data_complete() creates org_config if missing on login
ensure_user_data_complete() adds industry_type if missing on login
ensure_user_data_complete() creates trial subscription if none active on login
Registration without industry_type works (no NameError) - defaults to 'events'
Registration with industry_type correctly sets the industry configuration

critical_code_review_comments: The ensure_user_data_complete() function in auth.py is well-implemented and correctly handles all edge cases
Industry type mapping (template_to_type) is consistent across registration and backfill code
The enabled-modules endpoint correctly prioritizes industry configuration before plan/purchased modules
seed_data_creation: Advanced tests create test users directly in MongoDB to simulate missing org_config/subscription scenarios. All test data is cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug fix for back-filling missing organization_config and subscription on login is complete and verified. The ensure_user_data_complete() helper function in /app/backend/routers/auth.py handles: 1) Creating org_config with industry_type if missing, 2) Adding industry_type to existing org_config if missing, 3) Creating trial subscription if no active/trialing subscription exists. All auth flows (login, session, google callback) call this function.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Existing users who registered via Google OAuth before the industry system was implemented were missing organization_config records and/or the industry_type field. The enabled-modules endpoint requires industry_type to determine which modules to show.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added ensure_user_data_complete() helper function that is called on every login/session to back-fill missing data. This function: 1) Creates organization_config with industry_type if missing, 2) Adds industry_type to existing org_config based on industry_template, 3) Creates trial subscription if no active/trialing subscription exists.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 17 backend tests pass, including tests that directly create users in MongoDB without org_config/subscription to verify the back-fill logic works correctly.
